content: Melvin-Koushki argues that by identifying level seven with the divinatory science of jafr, Ibn Turka effectively awards the highest epistemological status to lettrism: the same lettrism as level six, but taken to its occult extreme and reserved for the elite of the elite.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
